Optional month selects a UTC month written YYYY-MM. Da

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar · Public sink: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar · Destructive: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar · Public sink: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar · Destructive: get_codex_reset_announcements, get_codex_reset_calendar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
